en: The Liturgy for the Thirty-Seven Honored Ones of the Vajraśekhara Yoga,
translated by the Tripiṭaka Śramaṇa Amoghavajra, Greatly Wise One,
Imperially Appointed Special Advancement and Acting Director of the Court of State Ceremonial, under Imperial Edict.
Homage to the Buddha Vairocana of the Pure Dharma-body.
Homage to the Buddha Akṣobhya of the Adamantine Solid Self-nature Body.
Homage to the Buddha Ratnasambhava of the Body Adorned with Merit.
Homage to Amitābha Buddha, the Body of Enjoyment-Wisdom.
Homage to Amoghasiddhi Buddha, the Transformation Body.

Homage to all Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas who have brought forth all pāramitās throughout the entirety of space and the pervasive Dharma-realm, born from the Vajra Pāramitā of Great Perfect Mirror Wisdom.
Homage to the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas who have emerged from the Jewel Pāramitā of the Wisdom of Equality, pervading all pāramitās throughout the entirety of space and the Dharma-realm.
Homage to the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas who have emerged from the Dharma Pāramitā of the Wisdom of Wondrous Observation, pervading all pāramitās throughout the entirety of space and the Dharma-realm.
Homage to all Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas born from the perfection of action of the Wisdom of Accomplishment (*kṛtyānuṣṭhāna-jñāna*), who pervade the entirety of space and the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas born from the Vajra-realm (*vajradhātu*) body, who are of one identical nature with all Tathāgatas, the Bodhicitta, and Vajrasattva Bodhisattvas, pervading the entirety of space and the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas such as Vajrarāja of the Bodhicitta, and to all Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas born from the Vajradhātu who share a single essential nature throughout the entirety of space and the pervasiveness of the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, the Bodhicitta-vajra-cchanda Bodhisattvas, and all the Bodhisattva-mahāsattvas of the various pāramitās who arise throughout the entirety of space and pervade the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhicittavajra-sādhu Bodhisattvas, and to all the Bodhisattva-mahāsattvas of the various pāramitās who arise throughout the entirety of space and pervade the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas such as Guṇasaṃcayavajraratna who have emerged from them, and to all Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas of the Pāramitās who pervade the Dharma-realm throughout the entirety of space.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas such as the Bodhisattva Vajraprabha, the Accumulation of the Merits of All Tathāgatas, and all other Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas who have brought forth the pāramitās, filling the entirety of space and pervading the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all the Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas such as Guṇasamudra-vajradhvaja who have emerged from the entirety of space and pervade the Dharma-realm, and to all the Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas of the pāramitās.

Homage to all the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas who have brought forth from the assembly of merits of all Tathāgatas, such as the Bodhisattva Vajrahasa, and who pervade the entirety of space and the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas who have emerged from the gate of wisdom of all Tathāgatas, the Vajradharma Bodhisattva, and so forth—those who pervade the entire Dharma-realm and fill the reaches of empty space, and who embody all the pāramitās.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Vajratīkṣṇa of the Wisdom Gate, and to all the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas of the Pāramitās who have emerged throughout the entirety of empty space and pervade the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Vajrahetu of the Wisdom Gate of All Tathāgatas, and to all the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas of the Pāramitās who arise throughout the entirety of space and pervade the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Vajrabhāṣa of the Wisdom Gate, and to all the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas of the Perfections who arise throughout the entirety of space and pervade the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas of the Great Vajra-Action of Supreme Diligence, and all other Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas of the Perfections who arise throughout the entirety of space and pervade the Dharma-realm.
Homage to all Tathāgatas, and to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas such as Mahāvīryavajrapāṇi, who have emerged from throughout the entirety of space and pervade the entire Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, and to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas such as Mahāvīryavajradaṃṣṭra, who have arisen from throughout the entirety of space and pervade the entire Dharma-realm, and to all the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas of the Pāramitās.
Homage to all Tathāgatas, and to the Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas such as Mahāvīryavajramuṣṭi, who have emerged from throughout the entirety of space and pervade the entire Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Vajralāsyā who delights the hearts of all, and to the ocean-clouds of offerings of all Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas born from the Vajradhātu—the single essence that fills the entirety of space and pervades the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, and to the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas such as Vimalavyūhajāmbūnadasuvarṇavajramālā, who have emerged from throughout the entirety of space and pervade the whole Dharma-realm, together with all the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas of the Pāramitās.
Homage to all the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas who have emerged from the wondrous Dharma-sound of all Tathāgatas as Vajra-songs, pervading the entire Dharma-realm and reaching the ends of empty space.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, the Bodhisattvas of the Vajra Dance of the Supernatural Powers of Action, and all the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas of the Perfections who arise throughout the entirety of space and pervade the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Mañjuśrī-vajra-dhūpa born from the perfuming of Suchness, and to all the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas of the Pāramitās who fill the entirety of space and pervade the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, and to the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas such as Vajrapuṣpa-vyūha, who have arisen from the supreme adornments, pervading the entirety of space and the Dharma-realm, and who have perfected all the pāramitās.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, and to the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas such as the Bodhisattva Constantly Universally Illuminating Vajra Lamp, who have brought forth all the Pāramitā Bodhisattvas throughout the entirety of space and the pervasiveness of the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Vajragandha whose precepts are cool and pure, and to all the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas who have emerged from the perfections, filling the entirety of space and pervading the Dharma-realm.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Vajrāṅkuśa of the Wisdom of the Four Means of Gathering [Beings], and to all the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas who have arisen from the Vajradhātu of the single essence that pervades the entirety of space and the Dharma-realm, manifesting in bodies born of the Vajra-realm, and who have accomplished all perfections.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattvas such as the Skillful Wisdom Vajra-lasso, and to all the emanated bodies born from the Vajradhātu who share the same single essence throughout the entirety of space and the Dharma-realm, as well as to all the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas who fulfill the instructions and the Pāramitās.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, to the Bodhisattva Vajraśṛṅkhalā of Firm Wisdom, and to all the messengers of the Tathāgatas born from the Vajradhātu—their bodies being of one identical nature, pervading the Dharma-realm and filling the entirety of space—to these Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas of the Pāramitās.

Homage to all Tathāgatas, the Bodhisattva Vajraghaṇṭā of Joyful Wisdom, and all others born from the single essence that pervades the entirety of space and the Dharma-realm; to all Tathāgatas born of the Vajradhātu, and to the Bodhisattvas Mahāsattvas who accord with the pāramitās.

On behalf of Brahmā, Śakra, the Four Heavenly Kings, the eight classes of devas and nāgas, emperors and sovereigns, teachers, monks, parents, spiritual friends, the assembly at this site of practice, and all sentient beings throughout the Dharma realm, I vow to sever all obstacles and take refuge in repentance.

With all sincerity, we repent! Disciples, from the beginningless and vast kalpas until this very day, we have been deluded regarding the awakening to non-self and have reckoned in terms of self and person. Once the notion of "I" arose, we constantly clung to "mine. The sense bases and objects swirled about us, and the aggregate of consciousness rushed forward, striking and agitating our body and mind like a flash of lightning. Our pure eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, and mind failed to awaken for even a single thought-moment; they were instead transformed into the six masters, who stole the wealth of the Dharma King to provide for the thieves of extreme views.
The bandits, having become rampant, have destroyed the city of Nirvana, ravaged the Dharma-body, and incinerated the life of wisdom.
Such transgressions as these exceed the sands of the Ganges in number; from delusion to further delusion, their beginning and end cannot be fathomed.

Now, having finally awakened, I deeply repent and feel ashamed; day and night I am filled with alarm and my body and mind tremble. I shall forever sever delusion and awakening, abandon craving for self and others, and enter the city of Nirvana to take refuge in the Land of Peace and Bliss.

By means of the realization of non-self, I shall subdue the six masters; I shall gather the wealth of the Dharma King and receive the treasury of the three jewels. I shall provide for the life of wisdom and augment the Dharma-body, lighting the lamp of the Dharma-nature to shine eternally and inexhaustibly. My practices and vows, both principle and phenomena, shall not conflict with the realms of dust and worlds. I vow to propagate and protect the Triple Gem and the Three Vehicles; may the transgressions of delusion and awakening be extinguished through this confession.
Having completed the confession and dedication, I take refuge in and pay homage to the Triple Gem with a sincere heart.
With a sincere heart, I make this vow:

May my disciples and all sentient beings of the Dharma realm, from this day forth until the attainment of unsurpassed Bodhi, remain firm in every thought-moment and advance in excellence in every thought-moment. May body and mind be autonomous and eloquence unimpeded; may they fully realize all-encompassing wisdom within a single thought-moment. They must understand that all phenomena are ultimately empty and quiescent, yet they shall constantly deliver and liberate all sentient beings, attaining Nirvana together with them, while not taking Nirvana as a final realization.
Having made this vow, one should with a sincere heart take refuge and pay homage to the Triple Gem.
This is the *Vajraśekhara Yoga Homage to the Thirty-Seven Honored Ones*.
